messages:
Marta: Hey team — thinking of escaping the city Saturday. Pt Reyes for a short hike + picnic? Or bikes on the coast. Anyone want to join? I can bring bread and coffee. :sun_with_face:
Devon: I'm in for bikes. Any idea on distance? :bike:
Sam: Ooh I'd rather hike. Can we do a short loop? — not 10 miles pls. :grimacing:
Lee: If bikes, I can bring panniers. If hike, I can bring a portable speaker. Either works. :+1:
Anya: count me out this weekend — family in town. but vote with Sam for short hike. :heart:
Marta: Great notes — sounds like short hike + picnic wins 3–1. Meeting at 9am BART or carpool? @Devon you drive?
Devon: I can drive 3 seats. @Sam @Lee want to share? I have a small roof rack for bikes.
Sam: I'll chip in for gas. Also does anyone have sunscreen? I forgot mine last time :sweat_smile:
Lee: I do — will bring SPF 50. Also linking a route: https://www.example.com/ptreyes-short-loop
OpsBot: Reminder — If you schedule this as a 'team outing', read People Ops guidelines re: reimbursements. See /policies/outing-reimbursement
Marta: Not official — just friends. But thx for the heads-up. I'll DM for car seats. :smile:
